claims: Potassium hydroxide is a strong alkali that can cause severe chemical burns upon skin contact.
Exposure to the eyes can lead to permanent damage or blindness.
Inhalation of its dust or mist can irritate the respiratory tract.

claims.text: Potassium hydroxide is a caustic agent that can cause respiratory, eye and skin irritation.
Eye protection and rubber gloves should be worn because the potassium hydroxide electrolyte is caustic.
